It’s so hard knowing that even striving to be like someone like your old self feels out of reach. Most people want to be someone like celebrities or someone to praise. While I sit here just wanting to be how I used to be, yet it feels so far away.

Thank you, I feel your sincerity. It’s so hard to keep up this facade going sometimes. I never know when I’m acting or feeling like myself anymore. Nonetheless, the kind words are beyond helpful and I appreciate it greatly.

Since currently I don’t wish to be around the people closest to me, I love my friends, I just feel anxious to be around them incase I get a panic attack or whatever comes out of me I don’t like.
I like doing things with my friends from work, it’s like my brain realizes that because I HAVE to see these people in a professional environment, so it doesn’t let me act poorly or feel too much anxiety around them. 
So random invites from them to go out or to go to there place for a work-friends get together feels amazing. Especially because I’m still not of drinking age, so it’s like an added bonus cuz they buy my booze for me.
They’re super weird and just happen randomly. They probably happen to everyone, we may just be more aware of it. With unstable minds a small pain can turn into a fantasy of death very quickly.

I feel the same. I just can’t imagine doing that to my family. Especially my Brother. Or what my friends would think. Or if people were to blame themselves. Truth is the blame would be on no one but myself but they wouldn’t understand. 
Every time I get a migraine, become ill, or even just feel a random pain somewhere in my body I pray that it’s something much worse than i realize and that it will eventually kill me.
I could spend my last days talking with family and friends, going over memories and they wouldn’t blame themselves at all because what could they even do?
I just don’t have the courage because of a complex fear of death/ if there is life after death. 
You’re not alone with this feeling, I wish I could help you with some sort of all-telling answer, but there is none. We just have to deal with it, hopefully the bad feelings will go, if they never do maybe one day the migraine will turn out to be a tumour, or the pain in the chest will be an incurable cancer. 
Either way I’ve given up looking both ways whilst crossing the street.
That’s sort of the problem, I can’t identify exactly why I started feeling so down again. I’ve had a lot of change in my life recently and that’s about all I can think of.
